name: Open a PR from the list (after previewing its findings) and load its review detail
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click into PR #482 and confirm the detail route loads with the PR title and review surface. Exercises nested routing (/repos/<id>/pulls/<number>) and the per-PR detail fetch. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where the demo repo acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md). Before opening the PR it hovers the FINDINGS column's severity icons and checks the read-only popover (spec specs/findings-popover.md): the seeded latest review has 2 findings, and the WARNING title only exists in the popover on this page. Escape closes it before the row click.
